en: Whoa there, folks!{PAGE}That thing's {f 0 1 2}copying your movement{f 0 1 0}!
Huh!? Whaddaya mean, "copy"? It's{SAUT}doin' the opposite of us!
Well actually, that's not true.{PAGE}The point-of-view has been reversed,{SAUT}not the direction. For example, if it{SAUT}faces us, and we move to the right...
Ohhh, I see―it'll look like it moved left!
Huh? It's copying us!?{PAGE}So, because we moved forward,{SAUT}that thing did the same thing?
So it seems. I believe if we were to head{SAUT}right, it would also move to its right, so...
From our point of view, it'll look like{SAUT}it moved left! I see, I see...
I don't get all this "right means left" stuff,{SAUT}but as long as we're careful, we'll be{SAUT}fine... Right!?
Indeed. All we must do is consider its{SAUT}movement as we proceed onward.{SAUT}You have the lead, Joker.
